commands:
set -e
. "/usr/local/share/GNUstep/Makefiles/GNUstep.sh"
"gmake" -C "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src" clean >/dev/null || true
"gmake" -C "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src/XCTest" CC=clang OBJC=clang ADDITIONAL_OBJCFLAGS="-I/usr/local/include"
if [ -f "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src/XCTest/obj/libXCTest.so.0" ] && [ ! -e "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src/XCTest/obj/libXCTest.so" ]; then
  ln -s libXCTest.so.0 "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src/XCTest/obj/libXCTest.so"
fi
"gmake" -C "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src" CC=clang OBJC=clang ADDITIONAL_OBJCFLAGS="-I/usr/local/include" xctest.all.tool.variables
"gmake" -C "/home/oracleadmin/tools-xctest-openbsd-arm64/src" CC=clang OBJC=clang ADDITIONAL_OBJCFLAGS="-I/usr/local/include" GNUSTEP_INSTALLATION_DOMAIN=USER install
